about: Dancer-popularity prior per recording (song id) from evidence of play that is not the DJ's own; built by scripts/build_popularity.ts (pnpm popularity:build), read by packages/core/src/popularity.ts. s: 0–1 (weighted mean of per-source rank percentiles within orchestra and era, over the sources with status ok); roles: s per slot role where the data places the song; ev: the evidence per source with counts, dates and its percentile.

setlists.note: 168 public set lists (Chris Jordan's DJ setblog, chrisjj.com) not already in the corpus

tangoInfo.note: tango.info is reachable (robots.txt: User-agent: Wget Disallow: /) but publishes no per-recording play counts; work page: performances / tracks / videos only, no play counts

deezer.note: rank of 619 sides with a Deezer id (api.deezer.com/track/{id})

spotify.note: GET /v1/tracks?ids= → HTTP 403; GET /v1/tracks/{id} answers without a popularity field for this app
